mapper.select: SELECT subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, MAX(level_code) AS levelCode, COUNT(*) AS hitCount, MAX(created_at_ms) AS lastHitAtMs FROM cw_subject_quota_hit WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at_ms >= #{sinceMs} GROUP BY subject_type, subject_id ORDER BY hitCount DESC, lastHitAtMs DESC LIMIT #{limit}
